description: This Swift source file defines an enum 'ShareToAgentSettings' that manages user defaults related to sharing instructions within an app. It provides methods to load and save default instructions, utilizing UserDefaults with a shared suite.

methods.name: loadDefaultInstruction
methods.description: Retrieves the default instruction string from shared UserDefaults or returns a fallback message if none is set.

methods.name: saveDefaultInstruction
methods.description: Stores a provided instruction string into shared UserDefaults, removing the key if the input is empty or nil.
